blind.description: A stylized ivory-toned skull resting on top of crossed bones, mounted on a heavy, faceted octagonal base made of dark wrought metal or carved stone. The base is detailed with gothic arch motifs and small raised pyramidal studs. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with clear hand-painted fantasy stylized texturing; no floating, fragmented, or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: Shows the rounded crown of the skull bearing hairline cracks, with the knobby ends of the crossed bones jutting outward from beneath, all centered on the dark octagonal base ring.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: ornate octagonal dark stone or iron plinth
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 3 ft tall) and roughly 3 to 3.5 ft wide across the base.

notes: Height is squatter than catalog target (approx. 1:1 aspect ratio instead of 2:1 height-to-width), though natural for skull and crossed bones on a low pedestal
